تسللن (form I)
# تَسْلُلْنَ (taslulna) /tas.lul.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla)
# تُسْلَلْنَ (tuslalna) /tus.lal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
